findings.summary: Official and linked-vendor surfaces resolve the same Clyde's of Georgetown at 3236 M Street NW, Washington DC 20007, phone 202-333-9180; no sibling location was merged.

No current official allergen matrix or Georgetown-specific cross-contact policy was found after all four searches. Search-indexed Toast allergy tokens are modifiers rather than item-level allergen claims.

Search indexing reflects an older Georgetown Toast catalog with products and an ALLERGY category absent from the live storefront. The live official July 30 menu and current exact Toast storefront control current scope.

Two baseline items persist under current names: Bell & Evans Half Chicken is represented by Lemon-Herb Chicken on current Toast, and Grilled Chicken & Farro Salad is represented by Grilled Chicken Salad.
Georges Bank Scallops, Trout Parmesan, and Warm Soft Pretzel are absent from every current exact-location surface and are stale rather than current.

Official and Toast current descriptions for Grilled Chicken Salad differ. The vendor presentation explicitly names toasted pecans and goat cheese, so current direct milk and tree-nut positives are retained from Toast rather than flattening the descriptions.

proposedChanges: Replace the 43-row partial Toast-only baseline with the current exact Georgetown union from five official food/nonalcoholic tabs and all 53 current exact Toast food items.
Normalize two renamed current products and remove three stale former products while preserving all frozen audit keys exactly once.
Add current brunch, raw bar, caviar, conservas, spirit-free, nonalcoholic beer/wine, dessert, coffee/tea, and kids brunch products omitted by the baseline.

Retain only current direct ingredient positives; do not treat Toast allergy modifier labels, vegetarian/gluten-free presentation labels, or absent matrix fields as blanket allergen or cross-contact claims.
